title: Type under pressure
description: Heavy club typography compresses and releases like a sound system finding its voice.
useCase: Create an expressive campaign headline or event poster where the type itself carries the identity.
reducedMotion: New editions appear immediately. Keyboard activation also skips the letter motion.
limitations: The two four-letter headlines are designed for this composition. Retune the type size and line height for longer copy.
look: Flat vermilion poster with huge tightly tracked black grotesque letters stacked in two lines between thick black rules and small monospace captions.
motion: Pressing the button swaps the headline; top letters rise from narrow slivers and bottom letters drop from wide flat bars, staggered 35 ms over 760 ms ease-out.
adapt: Letter motion is the `sf-typepress-set` and `sf-typepress-set-bottom` keyframes (760ms `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`) with per-letter `animationDelay` steps of 35 ms; re-keying the `h3` by `edition` replays them. Replace the `words` pairs and poster copy, retuning type size for longer words.
